sentences.en: Algerian historians need to be very particular about historical accuracy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的历史学家在历史准确方面需要非常严谨。

sentences.en: His speech was pleased by its accuracy, felicity, and fluency.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲因其准确、流畅和自然而受到称赞。

sentences.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
sentences.zh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。
